resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

In one line each, the fronts are: Arrow/DPI: deterministic observation cannot increase forward–reverse path-space KL; equality holds for identity observation. ( ) Protocol trap: holonomy can produce apparent protocol structure without honest entropy production, under a stationary initialization scope. ( ) Force implies cycles: nontrivial force-like structure requires non-forest support (positive cycle rank). ( ) Null force under exactness: if the log-ratio 1-form is exact (potential), cycle affinities vanish. ( ) Closure deficit: coarse closure deficit is a conditional-information obstruction characterized by a finite variational best macro kernel. ( ) Objecthood (bounded): strict contraction implies at most one fixed distribution; the theorem front addresses uniqueness and separation in the contractive total-variation regime. ( ) Idempotence no-ladder: idempotent packaging stabilizes after one step (no iterate ladder).
